allow: Bash(sed -E 's/\(ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=\).{0,12}.*/\\1<first chars hidden, length shown next>/' .env)

Bash(time curl -s -m 90 https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions -H 'Authorization: Bearer __CMDSUB_OUTPUT__' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free","max_tokens":2000,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Say hello in exactly three words."}]}')

Bash(curl -s -N -m 60 https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions -H 'Authorization: Bearer __CMDSUB_OUTPUT__' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free","max_tokens":2000,"stream":true,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Say hello in exactly three words."}]}')
